# Example

> Machine-readable index of this example site. Written by hand in the format
> the Starlight fixer generates: bare root-relative `.md` paths after
> `markdown:` (not `](...)` links) — the form `extractLinks` in
> `src/scanners/agent-headers.js` must also match, or the `.md` links are
> never probed at all.

- [Home](/): Home page — markdown: /index.md
- [About](/about): About page — markdown: /about.md
